Leadership rotated: energy XLE rolled from Leading to WEAKENING and out (rsMom 99.64, quad W), MAGS stays the strongest Leading megacap leg (rsMom 101.02), materials XLB still Improving/in, tech XLK/XLC turned Improving/in, and sector-research-lab now reads rotate toward XLP as XLE weakens. VIX is an easy 14.66 and volatility-sizing-lab stays NORMAL (throttle x1.37). The disciplined stance holds: HOLD the intact SPY/SPMO core and the first beta-add tranche while breadth stays narrow and SPMO (148.32) is still below its 50-day; keep the rest paused until breadth holds 60% across three bars and SPMO reclaims ~150.2; tilt toward the Leading megacap/materials legs now that the energy leg has weakened; and HOLD the now-repaired MSFT rather than chase the extended gap.
